entities.name: Query protein bL33
observations: 64 aa acidic-to-basic small protein; calculated molecular mass 7.42 kDa and pI 10.2.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Nostoc sp. bL33 reference Q8YNV9; 100% identity and coverage.
Pfam Ribosomal_L33 domain spans residues 9–64 with i-Evalue 5.5e-21.
Cysteine-rich motif is consistent with the zinc-binding architecture of bacterial ribosomal protein bL33, not a eukaryotic transcription-factor zinc finger.

entities.name: 50S ribosomal protein bL33
observations: Reviewed reference proteins annotate bL33 as a component of the 50S ribosomal subunit.
Annotated molecular function: structural constituent of ribosome.
Annotated cellular components: cytoplasm and ribosome.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: bL33 participates in bacterial protein synthesis as a structural component of the 50S ribosomal subunit.
